message.content:
{
  "diagnosis": "Actual terrain is visually flat and monotonous, lacking the broad asymmetric relief and macro-scale meadow variation required for strategic legibility. The prior green palette bleached the surface into an unattractive beige-grey. The dry grass and soil palettes are too warm and contrast too little with the meadow. No visible relief or compositional hierarchy exists beyond the protected city pad. The ground is not readable under the target camera.",
  "design_intent": "Introduce three broad asymmetric landforms: one gentle hill (2.5m) centered at [0, 0], one shallow basin (-1.2m) centered at [-60, 30], and one moderate hill (3.0m) centered at [40, -40]. These forms will create visible focal hierarchy, break visual repetition, and establish macro-scale relief without introducing micro-detail or noise. The meadow will be a restrained olive green with G>=R and G>B+30, dry grass will be warm earth tones with restrained contrast, and rocks will be warm grey. The original painted route-centre mask is preserved.",
  "palette_srgb": {
    "meadow": [80, 160, 60],
    "meadow_light": [120, 180, 80],
    "dry": [180, 160, 100],
    "soil": [160, 140, 100],
    "rock": [120, 110, 100],
    "path": [140, 120, 80]
  },
